# 🔎 SOC Dashboard
Real-time triage view for security analysts: active incidents, alert volume, MITRE ATT&CK coverage, and identity threat signals.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status in ('New','Active')
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo), CreatedTime, IncidentUrl
| sort by CreatedTime desc

SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize AlertCount = count() by Severity
| sort by AlertCount desc

SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Tactics = split(tostring(Tactics), ',')
| mv-expand Tactic = Tactics to typeof(string)
| extend Tactic = trim(' ', Tactic)
| where isnotempty(Tactic)
| summarize AlertCount = count() by Tactic
| sort by AlertCount desc

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where DeviceAction in ('Deny', 'Drop', 'Block')
| summarize BlockedAttempts = count() by SourceIP
| top 10 by BlockedAttempts desc

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType !in ('0','50125','50140')
| summarize FailureCount = count() by UserPrincipalName, ResultType
| where FailureCount >= 3
| sort by FailureCount desc

let MaxPlausibleSpeedKmh = 900.0;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == '0'
| where isnotempty(LocationDetails)
| extend Latitude = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.latitude), Longitude = todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.longitude)
| where isnotempty(Latitude) and isnotempty(Longitude)
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated), PrevUser = prev(UserPrincipalName), PrevLat = prev(Latitude), PrevLon = prev(Longitude)
| where UserPrincipalName == PrevUser
| extend HoursElapsed = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, PrevTime) / 3600.0, DistanceKm = geo_distance_2points(Longitude, Latitude, PrevLon, PrevLat) / 1000.0
| where HoursElapsed > 0 and DistanceKm > 250
| extend ImpliedSpeedKmh = DistanceKm / HoursElapsed
| where ImpliedSpeedKmh > MaxPlausibleSpeedKmh
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, DistanceKm = round(DistanceKm,0), ImpliedSpeedKmh = round(ImpliedSpeedKmh,0), IPAddress
| sort by ImpliedSpeedKmh desc

SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification, CreatedTime
| sort by CreatedTime desc

let TI = ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Active == true
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
    | project IndicatorId, NetworkIP, ThreatType, Description, ConfidenceScore = Confidence;
TI
| where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
| join kind=inner (
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceAction
) on $left.NetworkIP == $right.DestinationIP
| project TimeGenerated, MatchedIndicator = NetworkIP, ThreatType, Description, SourceIP, DeviceAction
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
